node: Private-label, contract manufacturing, packaging, and formulation for consumer staples and value retail
summary: Layer 1B expands the scarce-supplier universe for private-label and value-retail consumer staples. The best public-market matches are not broad retailers but narrow manufacturers, packaging suppliers, and retail-supply-chain infrastructure vendors that help retailers scale store-brand volume, comply with retailer onboarding rules, manage food-safety or product-spec requirements, and avoid packaging/order-flow bottlenecks. TreeHouse Foods would have been the most direct public private-label food manufacturer, but it completed a take-private transaction in February 2026, narrowing the current US-listed universe and increasing the relevance of remaining smaller public comparables such as Seneca Foods, Oil-Dri, Karat Packaging, and SPS Commerce.
